verdict.rationale: Gitea says it offers an API and webhooks for custom workflows, and it ships an official CLI (tea) and an official MCP server, which suggests broad programmatic access. However, nothing in the evidence shows the API matches everything the UI can do, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed docs paths. Missing for 10: documented API–UI parity, a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, per-feature API coverage (issues, Actions, packages, admin config), and independent hands-on corroboration of API completeness.
